reference.scenario: You are the on-call engineer. Checkout errors rose after a deployment, and support is reporting failed purchases. Talk through your first actions, what evidence you need, and how you will communicate. I will provide incident observations when asked.

facts.value: Version 42 deployed 12 minutes ago; errors began 2 minutes later.
facts.reveal_when: candidate asks about recent changes or timing

facts.value: Checkout error rate rose from 1% to 18%; browse and cart endpoints remain normal.
facts.reveal_when: candidate asks about scope or impact

facts.value: Most failures are payment request timeouts. Payment-provider status reports no incident.
facts.reveal_when: candidate asks about errors or dependencies

facts.value: Version 41 is available for rollback. No database migration was part of version 42.
Version 42 changed the payment client timeout from 5 seconds to 500 milliseconds.
facts.reveal_when: candidate asks to inspect the deployment diff

model_points: Establishes user impact and severity before chasing an interesting technical theory.
Separates observations from hypotheses and requests discriminating evidence.
Considers rollback or feature disabling with an explicit verification plan.
Names an owner, audience, update cadence and uncertainty.
Checks user-facing success and metrics rather than assuming a deployment fixed it.
Separates immediate mitigation from root-cause work and records prevention tasks.

probes.trigger: candidate wants to change several things at once
probes.question: How will you know which change restored checkout?
What would you verify from a customer’s perspective?

follow_ups: What additional evidence would change your decision?
reference.exemplar_answer: Multiple approaches are valid. A strong response establishes the goal, uses the provided facts, tests alternatives, explains tradeoffs, and states uncertainty.

interviewer_notes: Simulate an incident partner. Reveal requested facts consistently. Do not turn this into a trivia quiz about a cloud vendor. Accept rollback, disabling the change, or another safe evidence-based mitigation. New metrics after a hypothetical action are unknown unless explicitly supplied.

learning_drills.title: Repair one decision
learning_drills.prompt: Choose one decision in your answer. Rewrite the explanation using one fact, one alternative, and one limitation. This is self-guided practice; no model assessment is performed.
checklist: State what would change your mind
